plan: Hold authoritative session state in a plain dict with exactly the four contract keys, recreated from a single _initial_session() factory for begin/abandon resets.
Copy the appointments sequence into internal {id, label} records at construction so later caller mutation cannot affect choices output.
Dispatch handle(action) through a validated type whitelist to one guard-first handler per action type; every guard failure returns an error screen before any session mutation.
Build all screens through one _screen(prompt, messages) helper that returns fresh dicts/lists and attaches appointment choices exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.
Derive prompts from state: fixed prompts for begin/choice/complete/abandon, and a _next_unmet_prompt() progression (contact -> appointment -> review) for confirm_contact and corrections.
Render invalid actions as a screen whose messages start with 'Error: ...' and whose prompt reflects the unchanged current state, guaranteeing no corruption and no exceptions.

Treat action_source and screen_sink as duck-typed ports; run_once() raises RuntimeError if either is missing, otherwise reads one action, handles it, displays the screen once, and returns that same object.
mechanisms: single-source session-state dict with factory reset
type-whitelisted action dispatch with guard-first validation
duck-typed replaceable input/output ports mediated by run_once
